note: Private test IPA 755, for the maintainer's request of 16 November 2026 ("continue la corrections des blocs noir et les bandes de couleurs, c'est une priorité !"): the verified IPA 754 (run 43787137375, IPA 6b2c7b3e: NeoPlay's Chromecast route on base 753) with the S2Arm engine of patches 0001-0046 (run 43791231517, artifact 14192484178, verified pin 3b2e4f80). Patch 0046: a draw that tests depth EQUAL without writing it (a colour draw over a depth prepass) waits for its pipeline instead of being skipped while it compiles; skipped, it left the outline its prepass laid with the cleared colour, which is what the objects drawn all black in the maintainer's recordings of Mario Kart World look like (they came while the frame rate fell to 4-8, and every race session skipped 1,024 draws or more while their pipeline compiled); the cost is a longer stall where a new pipeline is met. S2A_RB_EQ_WAIT=0 in env.txt restores the skip. Patch 0045: a screenshot (side button + volume up) captures the next frame's render targets, pass snapshots and pass lines into Documents/Diagnostics/S2Arm/captures (one every 20 s, at most 4 a process; S2A_RB_CAPTURE=0 turns it off), to find what draws the vertical colour bands and the red-pink trunks, which this delivery does not correct. Patches 0001-0044 are those of 753. The RPCS3 Core stays the base's (Core 938): the RPCS3 session's Core 939 pin on the branch (de298373c) and its commits are deferred, its review not finished (c496f35b4); this manifest names a copy of the base's RPCS3 pin (build-utils/delivery/755-rpcs3-core-pin.json, sha256 5be5b4d6, equal to the 754 delivery's pin) so that HEAD's pin does not enter. The translator's sources are unchanged since IPA 750, so the device's translations and pipeline archive carry over. MeloNX, XeniaCore, the app and every other retained component are those of the base. Images that must change: S2ArmEngine and Runner. Build-only delivery: Flutter/native groups not-run. Nothing has run on an iPhone; no frame rate, stability or heat claim.
